title: pteridium japonicum
intro: Pteridium japonicum, commonly known as Bracken, is a type of fern that is native to East Asia, including Japan, China, and Korea. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and acting as an anti-cancer agent. The therapeutic actions of Pteridium japonicum include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and alleviate cough and asthma symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
